properties.rationale: Standing disposition for planned-but-unbuilt capabilities. The check named now because the interesting assertions are the downstream ones, not the vocabulary itself: storing a parent link proves nothing. The tests must be that a parent with fully-satisfied decomposed children reads as DELIVERED without carrying its own capability (extending cap:derived-completion), and that re-opening a Decision can name the derived requirements that existed only because of it. If either is cut, the distinction stops earning its keep under dec:edge-orthogonality and should be reconsidered rather than kept as an uncomputed label.
